context: This NPC is a long-time scavenger from the LOW prison who bartered with inmates and filched items from the dead and from confiscation stashes. In the SwA (speech-as-a-person) version — the one shown here — the rat speaks like a human merchant (calling himself Skittle/The Great Collector), runs a small wares-trade and peppers his talk with rat-like mannerisms and puns; in the non-SwA version he only squeaks or is rendered through narration. Off-screen, he’s been nursing a chipped tooth from gnawing at an item locked in a nearby chest; if the party treats him kindly he’ll lead them to that chest, and will excitedly jump in if the object is removed. Note: antagonizing rats elsewhere in the area can lead to larger rat-hostility or bargaining behavior, so repeated hostile interactions may escalate.
